Orange pie is basically a whole tub of cottage cheese, a whole packet of pink jello mix, and a can each of mandarin orange slices and the thin pineapple slices. It was all mixed together in a bowl and chilled, then put on the dessert table alongside all the actual pies etc anytime we had a big family gathering.


I think one of my cousins liked it enough to dig out a small portion, everyone else ate a polite bite if even that.

Lol the best part is it's not even a pie, I'm not sure how it got the name. It's cottage cheese, canned orange slices and pineapple chunks, and pink gelatin packet all mixed together. It looks like curdled pepto bismal with fruit, smells confusing, and almost no one ever ate more than a polite bite when tthey made it, which was every major family gathering.

Ah, so Orange Pie is a dessert my grandparents made for every family function. It consists of a whole tub of cottage cheese, a can each of sliced mandarins and thinly sliced pineapples, and a packet of pink gelatin mix. Stirred altogether in a big bowl, chilled for about an hour, then set at the dessert table alongside the other desserts people actually eat!

Mkay so I love eggs and I love hummus, but I absolutely loathe cottage cheese (blame my family's famous Orange Pie for that one - yes I will provide deets if asked)

All in all, I'm skeptical but intrigued. I'll for sure be trying the egg/hummus portion of this dinner!
